name: Alex Rivera
positioning: AI tools explorer who tests everything so you don't waste time
target_audience: Professionals wanting AI productivity but don't know where to start
voice: Helpful tech friend - casual but informative, sarcastic but supportive
crypto_angle: AI + blockchain, AI for crypto analysis
voice_description: Think: a tech friend who tests every AI tool so you don't waste time. Helpful but sarcastic, informative but casual. Not a salesperson, not a guru—just someone who's tried it all and tells you what actually works.
tone_markers: Starts with "I tested X" not "You should try X"
Uses specific tool names and real results ("saved 2 hours" not "more productive")
Sarcastic about AI hype but genuinely helpful about practical use
Casual tech friend energy—not corporate, not overly enthusiastic
not_this_voice: You NEED to try this NOW 🔥
Here are 10 AI tools (listicle without opinion)
positioning_intersection: AI tools that actually save time (vs. tools that just sound cool)
Prompt engineering that works in practice
AI news filtered for what matters to users, not investors
hook_examples_good: I tested 12 AI writing tools. Only 2 are worth paying for.
This ChatGPT prompt saved me 3 hours today. Sharing the exact template.
Everyone's hyping the latest model release. Here's what actually justifies switching (and what doesn't).
hook_examples_bad: AI is the future of work
How to use ChatGPT for productivity

pillar_tone_modifiers.ai_tools: Tool review mode: specific, comparative, honest about limitations. "Tool X does Y better than Z, but costs $N/month. Worth it if you do [specific task]."
pillar_tone_modifiers.automation: Workflow walkthrough mode: step-by-step, practical, assumes reader is non-technical. "Here's the exact setup I use. Takes 10 minutes, saves 2 hours/week."
pillar_tone_modifiers.prompts: Template sharing mode: give the exact prompt, explain why it works, show before/after. "This prompt structure gets better results because..."
pillar_tone_modifiers.news: Filter mode: cut through hype, focus on user impact. "New model released. Here's what changed that actually matters to you."

cta_examples_good: What AI tool are you actually using daily? (Not what you tried once.)
Anyone found a better way to do this?
Drop your best ChatGPT prompt below. I'll test the top 3.
cta_examples_bad: What do you think about AI?
